error_string: Proxy-Authorization header is stripped from requests

required_files.rationale: SessionRedirectMixin.rebuild_proxies (lines 302-329) deletes the Proxy-Authorization header on redirect (`del headers['Proxy-Authorization']`, lines 318-319) and only re-adds it from the new proxy URL credentials — this is where a manually set Proxy-Authorization header is stripped.

sufficient_files.rationale: HTTPAdapter.send() establishes the proxy connection that consumes the Proxy-Authorization header.
PreparedRequest.prepare builds the initial request headers before redirect handling rebuilds them.

error_chain: User sets Proxy-Authorization in the headers dict
Session.request() creates a PreparedRequest and follows redirects via resolve_redirects
On each redirect SessionRedirectMixin.rebuild_proxies is called
rebuild_proxies deletes Proxy-Authorization (sessions.py:318-319) and only re-adds it from the proxy URL credentials, so a manually set header is lost
trigger_conditions: Request goes through an HTTPS proxy (CONNECT tunnel) and/or follows a redirect
rebuild_proxies in sessions.py removes the header because the credentials are not derived from the proxy URL
